PES 2130.title: General Physics III
PES 2130.description: A continuation of PES 1120. Topics covered include fluid mechanics, waves temperature, heat and the first law of thermodynamics, kinetic theory of gases, entropy and the second law of thermodynamics, geometrical optics, interference, diffraction, light, and quantum physics.  3 Credits (Minimum) 3 Credits (Maximum).

ECE 3020.title: Semiconductor Devices I
ECE 3020.description: An introduction to semiconductor devices used in modern microelectronic technologies. The course objective is to provide an understanding of the fundamental physical principles and concepts underlying the operation and use of the most important semiconductor devices. College of Engineering students only. 3 Credits (Minimum) 3 Credits (Maximum).
ECE 3020.preReqs: ECE 2050, and either ECE 2205 or ECE 2210

CS 4500.title: Operating Systems I
CS 4500.description: Introduces concepts, terminology, and algorithms of operating systems. Describes semaphores, processes, virtual mappings, interrupts, resource allocation and management, protection, synchronization, scheduling, queuing and communication as applied to operating system design and implementation. 3 Credits (Minimum) 3 Credits (Maximum).
CS 4500.preReqs: CS 2060 or ECE 1021 with a grade of “C” or better; CS 2080 with a grade of “C” or better; CS 4200 or CS 5200 or ECE 4480 with a grade of “C” or better. College of Engineering students only
